issues.claim_quote: Across the whole packet, participant experience follows one dominant pattern shown by the cited source.

evidence.quote: Ladies are many more than men, so that is why you find a man has upto seven ladies or even ten because of the scramble for your pockets, that is what leads to having many ladies. So, there is a big chance that ladies exceed men with numbers.

issues.mechanism: Ignoring diverse individual experiences and presenting a single pattern across all participants.
issues.material_consequence: Creates a misleading impression of universal participant behavior.

review.rationale: The evidence presents anecdotal accounts and numerical observations related to a specific group (ladies exceeding men). This does not establish a dominant pattern across the entire 'packet' of participant experience, flattening diverse individual experiences.
